_note: Ask-it eval (im-answer-only ticket 02). Every run is one Telegram chat: the task message first (not scored; its tool calls are what the answer is checked against), then one of the asks, either in the same agent process (live) or in a new process that picked the chat back up from the engine log the way a channel restart does (resumed). `downloads`: the fake ~/Downloads, every name and every byte made up. `kind` says what the file's first bytes are (an ISO 9660 volume, a QuickTime / M4A container, a PDF, a JPEG, a real SQLite database, a real zip, plain text); `size` is its apparent size, the rest of the file is a sparse hole. `days_ago`: its modification time. `tables`: the SQLite file's tables and rows.

something, or to see the process (过程), recount it in a few lines from what
you already did; do not run it again.
